name: Render report
description: Render a Build report result into one alert comment laid out like the VMRay TheHive report: overview, detections, IOC summary, threat identifiers, MITRE ATT&CK, IOCs, analyses, screenshots and child samples.

report_path.description: The report file written by Build report — its `report_path` result.
report_path.title: Report path

report.description: The report itself — only used when Report path is empty. Only for small reports: a report with screenshots exceeds Sekoia's size limit on action inputs.
report.title: Report (inline)

max_comment_kb.description: Maximum size of each screenshot comment. Screenshots are split across as many comments as needed to stay under it — Sekoia rejects larger action inputs (SYM216).
max_comment_kb.title: Max comment size (KB)

content.description: The report as markdown, without screenshot images — ready for post-alerts/{uuid}/comments.
content.title: Content

screenshot_comments.description: The screenshots, split into comments of at most max_comment_kb each — post one comment per item (a Foreach over this list). Empty when the report has no screenshots.
screenshot_comments.title: Screenshot Comments
